result.notes:
Role advisor with advice/v1, config orch.advisor.* and questions=advisor, and three deterministic triggers in the conductor: a blocking question, red checks past check_fixes, and a Blocker/Major finding the triager rejected. Advice with needs_owner=false and a category outside human_gate is applied (question resolution by advisor, one more correction round, a repeated triage triage.<n>-a); any other advice is queued as a question to the owner with the advice. max_rounds (default 2 per piece) limits the loop. Each advice is advice-<n>.json in the artifacts and its agent run has causation equal to the problem. Launch catalog 1.4.0, role manifest, closed schema with fixtures, prompts, docs, CHANGELOG, golden orch-launch-list recaptured. Tests run: orch test_conductor_advisor (new, 28), test_conductor (157), test_conductor_session/heal/checks, a batch of 315 (settings, boundaries, schema_profile, cli_validate, launch, role_manifests, roles_text, conductor_contracts/prompts/questions/agents/research/input/autofix/focus, contracts_input/identity, render, research); bridges/planner-orch and bridges/orch-skiller suites; golden.py check and ecosystem-units check --strict also ran clean. The acceptance checks V1, V11, V12, V13 were not run by me.
